findings.title: The proposed repairs preserve irreversible commitments rather than deleting the unusual relationship
findings.type: positive written-rule finding with bounded scope
findings.assertion: C01 chooses delivery or fallback once at ordinary attack admission; C03 creates coverage only from a new eligible event and does not retrigger unchanged memory; C05 spends at charge lock and preserves that spend after interruption. Owner loss, occupied capacity and resource carry are now named. These are substantive rule additions and retain physical custody, taught endpoints and spatial attack fees. They establish several readable local transitions, not complete encounter or world-contract closure.

evidence.meaning: Admission/fallback order, owner retirement, seal carry and ordinary collateral.
Zone owner, event ID, single request, expiry and refill prerequisite.
Budgeted phase family, finite cycle, lock-time spend, resource carry and nominal/actual fee.

assumptions: These clauses supersede their named branches; all other original clauses remain inherited.
The durations and arena layouts are proposal parameters.
findings.readiness_implication: Preserve these local commitments for subsequent critique. Do not turn the original Balancer block into an independent pass.
findings.question_for_synthesis: Do the control and interpretation layers retain the same delivery, fresh-event and charge-lock boundaries, or assume a later rewrite/refund?

findings.title: Common safety admission remains an uninspected dependency with power to change the special relation
findings.type: scoped interface gap; possible cross-layer tension
findings.severity: high if complete recomposition is claimed
findings.assertion: The refined rules inherit ordinary hazard admission, common world resolution and action handover. C01 explicitly permits admission, delay or relocation of a warning; C03 requires new lethal warnings to account for already committed displacement; C05 can reject a charge before expenditure. C04 promises a compulsory future shove under current collisions. The fourteen frozen inputs do not supply a common operation contract specifying whose commitment wins, which warning may move, or what infeasible combinations do. That missing interface can alter the chosen lane, the endpoint response, the timing of a debt or the rate of budget expenditure. It is not evidence that the upstream contract does not exist, or that any candidate is impossible.

evidence.meaning: Inherited hazard-reachability contract may admit, delay or relocate the new sweep warning.
New lethal warnings account for committed compulsory displacement; optional later hits may create danger.
Pre-spend safety/admission rejection and inherited acquisition handover.
Compulsory deferred vector releases under current collisions.
Exact frozen input set inspected; common world/handover specification is referenced rather than included.

assumptions: Inspection is limited to this frozen input set; no claim is made about every document in the repository.
No hidden teleport, safety optimizer or guaranteed escape is allowed by the candidate responsibility statements.
findings.readiness_implication: Full recomposition remains unproved until the named shared interface is made inspectable and consistent with the special commitments. Numerical tuning alone cannot close an owner/precedence question.
findings.question_for_synthesis: Which layer promises ordinary lethal escape while the special rule commits a lane, endpoint or debt, and does its guarantee require changing that commitment?

findings.title: The raw region and stale-law drafts leave the operation that distinguishes them unresolved
findings.type: G0 written-contract gaps; discriminating operation prerequisite
findings.assertion: C02 remembers a cast starting inside and requires an outward crossing, but does not define the triangle construction for collinear marks, boundary membership, a cast/region expiry interaction, or what recovery means relative to spell completion. C06 separates current world law from an enemy last-read law, but does not define gate opening duration, crossing admission, route-cycle/reinspection ownership or what a blocked committed route does. Those operations determine whether the region differs from ordinary silence and whether rule versions differ from an ordinary delayed switch. Their G0 status is openly recorded; the gap is a requirement for the coming Distill pass, not a failed prior round.

evidence.meaning: Three interruption marks, eight-second triangle, origin/crossing requirement and recovery endpoint.
Feasible casting windows remain an explicit question.
Source-tile mutation, scout route commitment and later inspection.
Versioned inspection versus delayed gate switch is explicitly unresolved.
C02/C06 remain G0 and use pool as their current contract; the refined odd candidates are different inputs.

assumptions: A mark, cast, crossing and inspection must eventually have deterministic eligibility and event ownership.
A publicly named version need not itself alter the gate physics; that remains to be specified.
findings.readiness_implication: Do not infer a completed region or knowledge-state machine from its one-sentence concrete rule. Preserve origin memory and version identity while investigating whether their operations remain substantive.
findings.question_for_synthesis: Are controller and player-meaning claims using past crossing versus current position, or acquired law versus physical law, in ways the G0 rule cannot yet decide?

findings.title: Same-boundary finalization and overlapping compulsory motion remain open outside the courier repair
findings.severity: high for C04 contract closure; conditional for other candidates
findings.assertion: C01 now specifies arrival, deadline and attack-admission ordering. Equivalent boundary decisions are absent for a gesture hit at its ten-second expiry, a lease expiring when a charge locks, and a stored shove whose four-second timeout coincides with an attack or another incoming displacement. C04 also leaves second-hit admission, lethal damage and owner exit unspecified. Without one release/retirement owner, readers can assign different eligibility or accidental duplicate settlement. This does not prove duplication occurs; the text has not selected a branch. C06 similarly leaves edit, crossing and reinspection order at one boundary unresolved.

evidence.meaning: Positive comparison: explicit courier same-boundary order and owner loss.
Live preparation/expiry and eligible hit both exist, without their same-boundary tie order.
Lease activity is inspected at lock and reach/fee freeze there.
Attack or timeout releases one deferred vector; second-hit/death/owner-exit branches absent.
Mutation, physical crossing and reinspection are distinct events without a boundary order.

assumptions: Events may coincide in a deterministic update boundary; the proposal has not ruled that out.
Ordinary collision still governs physical movement; this finding does not prescribe a collision model.
findings.readiness_implication: Before a written closure claim, identify one terminal owner and boundary decisions for pending special effects. C01 supplies a useful precedent, not an automatically inherited global ordering.
findings.question_for_synthesis: Do control scripts or feedback traces assume a grace period, overwrite or cancellation that the rules have never promised?

findings.title: Failure funding and transferable reserves need transaction identity before their costs can carry across a run
findings.type: resource/lifecycle gaps and preserved reserve limitations
findings.severity: medium for G0 exploration; high if promoted as closed mechanics
findings.assertion: The refined odd candidates now separate run-owned player resources from phase-owned requests. Raw G0 C02/C04/C06 still do not state equivalent owner-exit, acquisition-pause or resource initialization/carry rules. C02 additionally leaves interruption eligibility, mark ownership/consumption and degenerate residue unresolved. All six reserves depend on an operation identity or ownership boundary: printed certificate matching/atomic first use; guard-break segment admission; agreeing phrase/rest and selected-item cycle; ordered retort capture/pruning; operative protection cost of shadow enlargement; and passport bearer/type/atomic crossing. These are preserved options, not completed transactions. The null protection liability in C05-V2 is already acknowledged and is not silently repaired here.

evidence.meaning: Explicit run seals and deferred certificate ownership/matching/consumption.
Gesture carry and shared-rest conflicts/item recovery deferred.
Acquisition freeze/collateral carry and undefined shadow protection cost.
Interruption-funded marks and one-region capacity, without a full funding lifecycle.
Claimed guard-break residue and opposing traversal eligibility.
Finite retort charge with ordered capture, three-second pruning and release.
Transferable editable one-use passport, with crossing consumption boundary still undeveloped.

assumptions: The goal frame includes three stages and mid-stage acquisitions; G0 proposals are allowed to be incomplete.
A fizzle is not assumed to be an eligible interruption; that definition is absent.
No free refill, automatic successful transfer or refund is inferred.
findings.readiness_implication: Keep reserves explicitly G0 unless the later round selects and closes their transaction. Complete representatives need a consistent resource/owner/pause lifecycle; broad symmetry or finite labels alone do not prove it.
findings.question_for_synthesis: Which liabilities are operational, and which cost or ownership transitions are assumed by the other layers only because the mechanic uses a familiar process metaphor?

evidence.meaning: Recorded turns, print/install, shared one-use gate.

evidence.meaning: Guard-break retained segment and opposing traffic.

reserve_coverage.rules_question: Which event creates/claims one segment, what counts as opposite traversal, and when does acceleration stop or ownership expire?

evidence.meaning: Two phrases, learned rest, one pending cycle, item eligibility.

reserve_coverage.rules_question: What if phrases disagree, the item is absent/in recovery, or phrase completion coincides with cycle admission?

evidence.meaning: Ordered retort capture and oldest record pruning.

reserve_coverage.rules_question: What if two attacks arrive together or a new attack/release coincides with pruning; can an occupied retort accept a third record?

evidence.meaning: Protection has no adequate operative cost while boss damage is removed.

reserve_coverage.rules_question: Which operation becomes harder when the lamp protects the boss, and what geometry owner resolves blocked shadow pulls?

reserve_coverage.rules_question: At which boundary does bearer/type eligibility freeze and one crossing consume the passport, including transfer/steal at that boundary?
